summary: Completed testing of WatchNexus marketing website and new Milk (Theme Forge) + Gadgets (Plugins) modules. All 18 backend tests passed. Marketing website (localhost:3001) fully functional with Homepage, Download, FAQ, and Demo pages. Main app Settings page shows Theme Forge tab with Milk branding and Juice color pickers, and Plugins tab with Gadgets branding.
critical_code_review_comments: Marketing website runs on port 3001 (Vite) - separate from main app on port 3000
Theme Forge tab shows 'Milk 🥛' branding with 6 built-in themes (TV, Movie, Anime, Music, Minimalist, Service)
Juice color pickers integrated for custom theme creation (Primary, Secondary, Background, Surface colors)
Plugins tab shows 'Gadgets 🔧' branding with 2 discovered plugins (AniDB Metadata Provider, Discord Notifications)
Build scripts exist but are untested (require actual OS environments)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing website runs on localhost:3001 (Vite). Main app at streamvault-209.preview.emergentagent.com. Theme Forge and Plugins tabs are in Settings page. All Milk and Gadgets APIs require authentication.
